original_style_2.name: Aetherweave
original_style_2.concept: Sound is tangible. Music weaves physical structures. Resonance creates architecture.
original_style_2.thesis: All forms emerge from wave interference patterns. Material is frozen sound.
original_style_2.coherence: Wave-derived forms, luminous materials, harmonic motion, warm amber + cool teal palette

original_style_3.name: Graphite Dusk
original_style_3.concept: The moment between day and night, rendered as if drawn by hand with graphite and charcoal.
original_style_3.thesis: All forms emerge from hand-drawn mark-making. Digital meets traditional draftsmanship.
original_style_3.coherence: Hand-drawn quality, visible hatching, lost-and-found edges, monochrome with warm undertones
